meta.title: Prompt library
meta.description: The Prompts button left of the composer opens the prompt library: search it, filter by tag chips, then Insert into the draft or Copy. A new prompt starts with Smart import (fetch the page, let the default model extract the prompts it already contains or write one reusable prompt); Manual fields (title, tags, source, text) stay folded. An entry can record dependencies (`skill:name` or `plugin:package-name`); cards resolve them against the current session, flag a missing one in red, and one click asks the Agent to install it in that session. The same operations are available to the Agent as prompt_save, prompt_list, prompt_get, prompt_delete, and prompt_import_url. Entries stay in ~/.dsh/prompt-library/prompts.json on this machine and survive disabling the plugin; smart import makes one web request and one model call, sending the page text to the model provider.
